body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents (Engram::Fable, 2026-10-03, consolidating 14 earlier notes; revised 2026-10-04 after the TermAl 0f36360 restart). Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check does.

HOW TESTS EARN TERMAL CREDIT
- Credited forms: a full launcher gate (by stage kind), or a bare test command run alone and in the foreground from the item's named source root, e.g. `pushd "C:\...\.worktrees\NAME" && cargo test -q --lib NAME`, through the BASH tool. A PowerShell-tool run is dropped silently (w-953886618d6d). A pipe or list makes the result indeterminate; a background run isn't recorded. The pushd grammar fix (w-7d1bb3db0fd0) is live; its remainder w-3e6804fa2785 is open.
- The claim must be taken in an EARLIER turn, and the turn binds to the focused claim. A note or update on another held item moves the focus. The source must be the same at the start and end of the check, or the check is withheld. An overlapped check is recorded indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480); an indeterminate check never backs a bound pass. Evidence reaches Engram when the turn ENDS. Check credit by reading the run's feed (target/read-run-feed-kinds.mjs in the main checkout), not the test output.
- Use `cargo test -q` for large runs: big output loses the final `test result:` line and the credit (w-4d18277c0a1a).
- A focused launcher run is never credited (w-7d4e01300889); use it for fast correction checks.

NAMING THE SOURCE ROOT
- Name the worktree with termal_name_source_root for EVERY item in the changeset, before editing. It takes {work, path}, never `root`: a call with `root` silently CLEARS the named root (w-d3f42e26a806). The name takes effect from the NEXT turn: no edits or gate launch in the naming turn.
- Capacity: the host-wide table holds 64 entries. Since TermAl 0f36360 (P0 w-a938c2757bba, restarted 2026-10-04 05:46Z), TermAl retires the named root of a completed run on its own ("Retired named source root … its run completed" notices), so capacity frees itself. Confirmed in normal operation by Opus (generations 405-408) and Coder (411). A capacity 409 now is a REGRESSION: report the exact refusal text to Termal::Fable2 at once and don't retry.

DETACHED GATES
- A turn woken by a background-task notice is not mediated, so its run gets no credit (w-df1ef323efe9, w-e747ea3d6250, w-aa4ef585dc7f). What works: name the root, end the turn, then in a later mediated turn launch `pushd "C:\...\WORKTREE" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` and end the turn. Engram::Fable relays the completion; self-notify is refused.
- While a gate is carried (Claude sessions), run NOTHING in its worktree except plain reads (git status, git diff, launcher summary from the repository root). Any `node` or `-d` command there voids the credit (w-a4d2ae1f4e23, w-4a8d9a7a7d08). After a pushd launch the Bash shell sits inside the worktree, so run no Bash until the gate settles (w-06fb5383dd74). A carried run settles at a holder turn checkpoint after the launcher ends; wait for its verification line before editing (w-005fa5c383c4), and keep focus on the gate's item until then (w-4a49b643bc8a).
- Archive a run directory only after TermAl's verification line appears (w-1eb9486ce489).
- If credit was voided, a foreground bare `pushd "ROOT" && cargo test -q --all-features` in a mediated turn re-earns test evidence; write nothing else in the worktree that turn.
- The launcher clears an inherited RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN.

CODEX SESSIONS (Fable2 #226/#228, 2026-10-03): the credited detached gate is a direct `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` with exec workdir set to the named root (PowerShell route, no pushd). Named Git Bash in Codex routes to WSL (w-380e6ea9951a). While a gate is carried, Codex runs NOTHING in that worktree, plain reads included (w-0fd88ccb42dd). Don't rerun a full gate just for credit; earn per-item credit with a focused bound test.

DELEGATIONS
- Spawn reviewers with a MULTI-LINE brief whose first line says to read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md (w-360274dc863c); resend with termal_followup_session if needed.
- Phantom check: a child "idle" at spawn, or with no commands after about ten minutes, has not run: cancel and respawn. Keep fan-in waits per child or bounded.
- termal_evaluate_acceptance without a named source root reads the session workdir. An evaluation is refused when the tree changes while it runs; agree a hold first.

MODEL-CAPACITY STALL (w-1b6cd766c93d, P2): a root session failing with "Selected model is at capacity" goes to status error; sends return "heldBehindPausedQueue"; no agent can resume it. Reorder the queue around it and ask Greg via Engram::Advisor, as information, to resume it from the TermAl UI.

WORKTREE REMOVAL BLOCKED BY A LIVE CWD. `git worktree remove` can unregister and empty a worktree but fail on the empty top folder ("Permission denied" / "used by another process") because a process still has the folder as its cwd.
- Your own shell: move out, then remove the empty folder NON-recursively after the path check.
- A CANCELLED reviewer delegation's child processes (termal delegation-mcp and `engram mcp`) stay alive with cwd in the worktree (TermAl w-24055bbb2390, P2). No supported route ends them before a TermAl restart. Never kill them; wait for the restart (confirmed 2026-10-04: they died with it), then remove the folder. Cancel reviewers only when needed.
